Name: LOOK_AT_SPINE_PARAM_ST
Description: Look-at settings that turn a character's hips, spine, shoulders and arms towards its aim target: how much of the turn each joint takes, angle limits and turn speeds, on the ground and in the air. Rows are selected from TAE.

Fields.Name: Look-At %: Root
Fields.Description: Base rate of the look-at.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Look-At %: Hip
Fields.Description: Share of the horizontal look-at turn taken by the hip (BD_Root) joint.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Look-At %: Shoulder
Fields.Description: Share of the horizontal look-at turn taken by the shoulder joint.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Look-At %: Wrist
Fields.Description: Share of the horizontal look-at turn taken by the wrist joint.

Fields.Name: Vertical Look-At %: Hip
Fields.Description: Share of the upward look-at turn taken by the hip (BD_Root) joint.

Fields.Name: Vertical Look-At %: Shoulder
Fields.Description: Share of the upward look-at turn taken by the shoulder joint.

Fields.Name: Vertical Look-At %: Wrist
Fields.Description: Share of the upward look-at turn taken by the wrist joint.

Fields.Name: Limit Angle: Hip (Left)
Fields.Description: How far the hips can turn to the left. In degrees, -180 to 180.

Fields.Name: Limit Angle: Hip (Right)
Fields.Description: How far the hips can turn to the right. In degrees, -180 to 180.

Fields.Name: Limit Angle: Hip (Up)
Fields.Description: How far the hips can turn upwards. In degrees, -180 to 180.

Fields.Name: Limit Angle: Hip (Down)
Fields.Description: How far the hips can turn downwards. In degrees, -180 to 180.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Look-At %: Lower Back
Fields.Description: Share of the horizontal look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA) joint.

Fields.Name: Vertical Look-At %: Lower Back
Fields.Description: Share of the vertical look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA) joint.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Limit Angle: Root (Up)
Fields.Description: How far the body can tilt upwards when shooting in the air. In degrees, -180 to 180.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Limit Angle: Root (Down)
Fields.Description: How far the body can tilt downwards when shooting in the air. In degrees, -180 to 180.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Vertical Look-At %: Root
Fields.Description: Share of the upward look-at turn taken by the body (Root) tilt when shooting in the air.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Vertical Look-At %: Hip
Fields.Description: Share of the upward look-at turn taken by the hip (BD_Root) joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Vertical Look-At %: Lower Back
Fields.Description: Share of the vertical look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA) joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Vertical Look-At %: Shoulder
Fields.Description: Share of the upward look-at turn taken by the shoulder joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Vertical Look-At %: Wrist
Fields.Description: Share of the upward look-at turn taken by the wrist joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Look-At %: Lower Back [EX_A]
Fields.Description: Share of the horizontal look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA_EX_A) joint.

Fields.Name: Vertical Look-At %: Lower Back [EX_A]
Fields.Description: Share of the vertical look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA_EX_A) joint.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Vertical Look-At %: Lower Back [EX_A]
Fields.Description: Share of the vertical look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA_EX_A) joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Look-At %: Lower Back [EX_B]
Fields.Description: Share of the horizontal look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA_EX_B) joint.

Fields.Name: Vertical Look-At %: Lower Back [EX_B]
Fields.Description: Share of the vertical look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA_EX_B) joint.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Vertical Look-At %: Lower Back [EX_B]
Fields.Description: Share of the vertical look-at turn taken by the lower back (SpineA_EX_B) joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Look-At %: Pelvis
Fields.Description: Share of the horizontal look-at turn taken by the pelvis (hip joint).

Fields.Name: Vertical Look-At %: Pelvis
Fields.Description: Share of the vertical look-at turn taken by the pelvis (hip joint).

Fields.Name: Aerial - Vertical Look-At %: Pelvis
Fields.Description: Share of the vertical look-at turn taken by the pelvis (hip joint) in the air.

Fields.Name: Lower Vertical Look-At %: Hip
Fields.Description: Share of the downward look-at turn taken by the hip (BD_Root) joint.

Fields.Name: Lower Vertical Look-At %: Shoulder
Fields.Description: Share of the downward look-at turn taken by the shoulder joint.

Fields.Name: Lower Vertical Look-At %: Wrist
Fields.Description: Share of the downward look-at turn taken by the wrist joint.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Lower Vertical Look-At %: Root
Fields.Description: Share of the downward look-at turn taken by the body (Root) tilt when shooting in the air.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Lower Vertical Look-At %: Hip
Fields.Description: Share of the downward look-at turn taken by the hip (BD_Root) joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Lower Vertical Look-At %: Shoulder
Fields.Description: Share of the downward look-at turn taken by the shoulder joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Aerial - Lower Vertical Look-At %: Wrist
Fields.Description: Share of the downward look-at turn taken by the wrist joint in the air.

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Priority of this row when it is set from TAE.

Fields.Name: Aim Arms Before Parent Joint
Fields.Description: If ON, the arms and shoulders turn to the target angle even if the parent joint (the hips) has not reached it yet. Set it ON to turn the arms first and let the hips follow later.

Fields.Name: Maximum Horizontal Rotation: Shooting
Fields.Description: Maximum horizontal turn speed of the whole hip and arm look-at when shooting starts. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Maximum Vertical Rotation: Shooting
Fields.Description: Maximum vertical turn speed of the whole hip and arm look-at when shooting starts. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Maximum Horizontal Rotation: Hip
Fields.Description: Maximum horizontal turn speed of the hips. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Maximum Vertical Rotation: Hip
Fields.Description: Maximum vertical turn speed of the hips. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Maximum Horizontal Rotation: Arm
Fields.Description: Maximum horizontal turn speed of the arms. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Maximum Vertical Rotation: Arm
Fields.Description: Maximum vertical turn speed of the arms. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Maximum Horizontal Rotation: Not Shooting
Fields.Description: Maximum horizontal turn speed of the whole hip and arm look-at when not shooting. In degrees per second. Planned for removal.

Fields.Name: Maximum Vertical Rotation: Not Shooting
Fields.Description: Maximum vertical turn speed of the whole hip and arm look-at when not shooting. In degrees per second. Planned for removal.

Fields.Name: Look-At Release Time: Grounded
Fields.Description: Time taken to release the hip and arm look-at after shooting ends. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Look-At Release Time: Aerial
Fields.Description: Time taken to release the hip and arm look-at after shooting in the air ends. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Interpolation Duration: Parameter Change
Fields.Description: Interpolation time when switching to this row from another look-at row. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Interpolation Duration: Target Switch
Fields.Description: Interpolation time for changing the look-at direction when the target switches. In seconds.
